classifiedFinding.title: Uncapped desiredAPYBps converts directly into unbounded phUSD mint pressure

symbolic: SYMBOLIC-005 PASS (two-step gate state-machine proven correct — gate provides exactly the 100-block delay and nothing more)

classification.assetImpact: Owner can set arbitrary APY; combined with phUSD being both stake and reward, owner can pre-stake → hike APY → claim → exit, with only a ~20-minute friction window. Affects phUSD supply system-wide.
attackPath: 3. Owner waits ≤100 blocks, calls setDesiredAPY(huge_value) — commit.
4. Time passes; owner accrues phUSD via _claimRewards.
5. Owner withdraws + claims, extracting freshly-minted phUSD.
classification.likelihood: depends on owner trust; the function is onlyOwner-gated

classifiedFinding.justification: onlyOwner setter with no on-chain magnitude cap. Per C4, pure owner-controlled inflation is a Centralization risk. KI-1 acknowledges the gate exists; KI-5 acknowledges owner trust. The fresh angle (no magnitude cap, only delay) is a structural critique of the gate's design intent. Routes to the Centralization bundle with a recommendation to add a hard cap and a longer time-based window.
classifiedFinding.notes: Sanitizer hinted potential-high. Classifier disagrees: the trigger is owner-only action. The 'gate is delay-only, not magnitude bound' framing is strong C commentary but does not escape onlyOwner gating. C.
